sermon.title: Needless Hurt and Death — November 8, 2020
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: After communion, Pastor David G. Kincer teaches from Jeremiah 22 that truth eradicates preventable harm and death. God told the king to execute judgment and protect the stranger, fatherless and widow. He cites statistics on preventable deaths, urges the church to use its freedoms, and challenges each believer to set a dated goal and take on one injustice.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.
